data: Which of the following metrics are represented in the figure?

The figure represents four metrics:

1. In-domain accuracy - represented by the red line.
2. OOS recall - represented by the blue line.
3. OOS precision - represented by the green line.
4. Latency - represented by the black line.

These metrics are plotted against the Top k values on the x-axis and their respective percentages or milliseconds on the y-axis. The caption confirms this analysis.
